payload.query: fabric care wool blazer machine wash

payload.snippet: Wool-blend jackets can be machine-washed on a cold/delicate cycle (30C or below). Use a mesh laundry bag to prevent snagging.
Tumble dry on low heat for no more than 10 minutes, then reshape while damp and lay flat to finish drying.
Size M tops fit a chest of 38-40 inches. Regular fit: standard cut with moderate ease.
All items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unworn with tags attached.
